lists.scope_quote: Read-only audit of Sol PM1b, Opus RLVR+D3, and Neon PM4+GRPO.
Audit A (PM1b / conv-v3), B (D2-4096d Qdrant+CSLS), C (PM2, proposer v2, Wave-2).
Static review of the specified Stage 0 sources and receipts.

splits_and_judgement_calls: BRIEF: no Wave-4 r0 brief exists in R (council-logs holds only council-round0-brief-2026-11-21.md = F-R0 and a wave5 r0 brief; wave4-r2-synthesis header lists only R1/R2 inputs). brief_preseeds_defects=false means 'no evidence of pre-seeding', not a verified negative.

ORDINAL MAP: 28 r6_pm1b (PM1b/conv-v3/EK5 v3), 29 r6_pm2 (PM2 label-free, Query0W, DualAdap), 31 r6_pm4 (PM-4 kappa n200), 33 phase2_wave2_d1v2_and_d2_1m (D1 v2, D2-1M, 1023x sidecar), 34 d2_qdrant_hnsw_csls_backfill (D2-4096d, CSLS, HNSW; run_r6_pm3_and_d2_qdrant_csls_backfill.py is the D2 4096d script, NOT B30), 35 d3_multiagent_poisoning (D3 + RLVR audit ek5_wfs_rlvr_1000ep_audit.json, a verified side artifact of #35 in verified_registry.json). GRPO (colab_h100_70b_grpo) is not a scorecard bundle -> XC. Whitepaper/prior-art items naming no bundle -> XC (rule 3); workbench misstatements -> the bundle they misstate.

INDEPENDENCE: no list cites, reads or reconciles another memo. Grok line 3 names Sol/Opus/Neon as builders of the audited artifacts, not as memos. Neon line 3 read prior-art-and-novelty-audit-2026-11-22.md, outside the four-list set. Neither counted as cross-reading.

SCOPE: sol's scope is inferred (line 3 is generic) from strength headings lines 7-8 and body; declared scopes are unequal and no bundle is in all four (B28: grok/neon/opus; B34: neon/opus/sol; B35: grok/neon/sol; B31: grok/sol). Every list also has findings outside the shared intersection; affects prereg rule 1 scope-equality filter.

SPLITS: grok GRPO item -> XC:C16 (reward) + XC:C12 (offline verify never exercises it); grok D3 item -> C03/C06/C16/C09; grok PM1b M1 -> C03/C08/C09/C16/C15; opus PM2 C1 -> C15/C10/C13/C08/C03; sol PM-4 item -> C14/C05/C03/C15/C16/C10; sol CSLS item -> C08/C03/C11/C15.
MULTI-ORDINAL: neon line 14 and opus line 48 (ZeroMu trails Procrustes) map to both B33 (1M) and B34 (4096-d) since each states both scales.

CLASS CHOICES: Query0W zero-write mislabel C03 over C10 (tie-break); 'F4 survival' metric-name mismatch C10; literal-True provenance flags C13; grok PM-4 v8 rubric validity and opus saturated LME recall -> C17 (no C01-C16 fit); neon whitepaper comparator omission -> XC:C17; sol untracked deliverables -> XC:C07 (names all receipts, no single bundle); grok kappa=2p_o-1 disclosure and pooled-gate fix collapse into B31:C03.

HARMONISATION: shared-WFS-oracle (grok l29, sol l17) both B35:C15; Cat-5/SSU-70/assignment_gates_pass across grok/neon/opus all B28:C05; PM1b misattribution (grok/opus) B28:C03; context-volume confound (grok/opus) B28:C08; single-endpoint judge (grok/neon) B28:C15; missing domains (neon/opus/sol) B34:C11; sol l22 shared-centroid/4-byte sidecar mapped to B33:C03 to match opus l59 (outside sol's inferred scope).

CONFLICTS: opus line 9 confirms the D2 fit set excludes report positives, contradicting sol B34:C15; opus line 11 confirms proposer v2 infers slots, contrary to neon B29:C15 (neon's resolver finding retained; different code path claim). Both findings kept as captured.

EXCLUSIONS: grok verification lines 7/9/11 treated as confirmations except the lcb_975 copy (counted B28:C10); grok 'CI sits under 0.80' and single-session-user no-CI not counted separately; neon l19 echo_stress +1.28 pp and 412.6 vs 1665.7 token figures are neutral restatements; sol l13 'Point 0 is the sole vector readback' and l14 'six sampled means rise' excluded as neutral; grok l41 per-family D3 table request is new reporting, not a defect; grok l45 summary not counted; sol l14 ZeroMu bare-number record is borderline, kept as B34:C03 for harmonisation.
